StoredMessage.description:
A message an actor keeps to send later (ADR 0028): its type name and its JSON payload, as a store holds a message.
The actor that keeps it knows where it goes, so it holds no address. Build one with `StoredMessage::for_ref`.

payload.description: The payload: the fields of the variant, without the type tag.

type.description: The type name: the variant of the family.

Deliver.description:
Sends the message to one subscriber, when it is still a subscriber. Sent by the topic to itself, with a retry
policy.
Deliver.title: Deliver

Failed.description:
The notification of a message to a watched actor that ended `failed`: what the failed message was and why it
failed. Its type name is `Failed`. A watcher's message family declares it as `Failed(cicada::Failed)`.

Its schema is part of every watcher's contract; a snapshot test pins it.

actor.description: The actor the failed message was for: the actor of the event, not the target of the watch.

attempts.description: How often the message was claimed: its `attempt`.

cause.description: What failed: the handler, the node, the message, the state, the commit, or the claim limit.

oneOf.description:
The handler returned an error or panicked, and no retry is left; or it returned a new state that cannot be
stored.

The node or the store failed around the turn: a read the node needed failed, also one the handler passed on,
or a panic outside the handler.
The handler refused the message for good (a permanent failure).
The turn ran past its maximum duration.
The state or the address of the actor cannot be read by its type.
The effects of the turn were refused, or its commit was rejected or refused.
The message reached the claim limit (ADR 0025).

correlationId.description: The correlation id of the failed message; null when it has none.

from.description: The sender of the failed message; null for a message sent from outside a turn.

messageId.description: The id of the failed message.

messageType.description: The type name of the failed message.

payload.description: The payload of the failed message.

Failed.title: Failed

A message an actor keeps to send later (ADR 0028): its type name and its JSON payload, as a store holds a message.
The actor that keeps it knows where it goes, so it holds no address. Build one with `StoredMessage::for_ref`.

payload.description: The payload: the fields of the variant, without the type tag.

type.description: The type name: the variant of the family.

Publish.description: Sends the topic one `Deliver` for each subscriber, with the correlation id of the publish.
Publish.title: Publish

Stopped.description:
The notification of a watched actor that went away. Its type name is `Stopped`. A watcher's message family declares
it as `Stopped(cicada::Stopped)`. Only a watch on the actor's own address tells of it.

Its schema is part of every watcher's contract; a snapshot test pins it.

by.description:
The actor whose turn removed it: the actor itself when it stopped, the stopping ancestor when it went with it;
null for a removal from outside a turn.

oneOf.description: It was deleted from outside a turn.
It was removed with its parent (ADR 0019).

Stopped.title: Stopped

Subscribe.description: Adds a subscriber, and watches the topic itself.
Subscribe.title: Subscribe

state.description: The state of a [`Topic`]: its subscribers, in the order they subscribed, each once.
state.title: TopicState
